svg.text: The same simple figure as a black silhouette with an amber rim, lit eyes and a smile. No legs: below the waist it narrows into one thread tied to whatever feeds it.
amber typewriter, lowercase, typed on letter by letter next to it
the narrator is the opposite: white, sentence case, at the bottom
• same rig as Owen, drawn as a silhouette: no extra animation work
• amber rim, eyes and smile; tied by a thread, no floor ring
• it grows 1 → 4 as it wins; only at 4 does it get his tuft
• when it loses, the thread goes slack and the glow dies
